summary: Continuwuity is a community-driven Matrix homeserver written in Rust. As a fork of the conduwuit and Conduit projects, it aims to provide alternative messaging server capabilities with a focus on user experience and new features.
goodFor: This project suits administrators looking for an alternative Matrix homeserver implementation written in Rust who want to experiment with community-led development.
watchOut: The software currently has no tagged releases and lacks recent commit activity, indicating an early or inactive development stage with unknown stability.
deployNotes: Container images and Debian packages are available for deployment, and you will typically need to configure persistent storage and a reverse proxy for TLS termination.
